text: Figure 10.9: Example how IDs have to be in sync During the configuration of the PHM the PHM artifacts are created. At target- configuration state there is no access to the design model available, thus the numeric values used for checkpointId at the Interface definition ( PhmSupervisedEntity- Interface) are not available to the Phm. Therefore the numeric values for checkpointId are replicated in the target- configuration model of the PHM: SupervisionCheckpoint.checkpointId repli- cates PhmCheckpoint.checkpointId
